theme: A rare open day before tomorrow's move.
greeting: The calendar's clear all the way through today, Dan - no meetings, just open hours. Tomorrow you change houses and take the Brunswick call, so today is the one to spend on the things that have been waiting.

needsAttention.title: Conor Kehoe is waiting to schedule
needsAttention.detail: His office sent a Zoom invite to lock a time for the PRI stewardship chat Eugenia Jackson introduced back in July; it has sat unread since yesterday, and he asked whether a conversation would still be useful.

needsAttention.title: The travel larder bin isn't packed
needsAttention.detail: It was meant to be built before tomorrow's changeover to the St. Pete Ranch house, so the flavor spine travels with you rather than getting rebought at each stop.

needsAttention.title: Pre-departure bookings still open
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 19 night in Cavtat and the Sept 20-22 St. Pete landing gap are both unbooked, and each has to be locked from dry land before you sail on the 8th.

needsAttention.title: Bio still owed to Ellen and Deb
needsAttention.detail: Your own flagged note to send your email address and board bio to Ellen and Deb has been open since Monday.

needsAttention.title: Brunswick call prep
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow's intro Teams call with Lauren Nadig lands better with a clear line on what you want from Brunswick and how you're framing the board search.

flagged.title: Conor Kehoe scheduling request
flagged.detail: His office is ready to book the PRI stewardship chat; unread since yesterday.

inbox.noise: The rest of the inbox is promotions, newsletters, and spam - nothing needing you.

resolved.title: Brunswick call is set
resolved.detail: You accepted and Lauren Nadig confirmed; it's on the calendar for tomorrow at 3:30 PM.

recipe.title: Fricassée of chanterelles
recipe.why: Early autumn is peak chanterelle season, when the woods give up their best foraged mushrooms.

tasks.title: Confirm checked bags are on the Croatia ticket
Book refundable backup car, Sept 20 - Oct 5 (TPA)
Buy EU plug adapters and a US power strip

acts.line: A clear morning, nothing on the calendar to answer to.
Still no meetings - the open hours are yours to steer.
Your last night in the Kenwood house before tomorrow's move across St. Pete.
